summary: rollout.py warns 'failed to switch adapter' because POST /v1/active_adapter returns 404. The active-adapter switching endpoint name differs from what we tried (/v1/active_adapter, /v1/adapter/active, /v1/adapters/active). For now we proceed against whatever adapter is loaded — which is fine for baseline because no adapter is active by default.
repro_hint: curl -X POST http://localhost:8420/v1/active_adapter -d '{"name":""}' → 404. Search kiln-server adapter routes for the canonical path.

summary: kiln-server agent_traces.rs parser expects pi session JSONL with top-level 'messages' arrays and 'tool_calls' lists. Pi 0.75.1 actually writes one event per line with the message under 'message' (singular), and tool calls inside content blocks (type='toolCall', name=str, arguments=dict). The mismatch means the kiln /v1/agent/traces endpoint will mis-count or fail to parse most current-pi sessions.
repro_hint: Compare crates/kiln-server/src/api/agent_traces.rs parse_pi_session() against a real pi 0.75.1 session JSONL. The block type is 'toolCall' (camelCase), input lives under 'arguments' (OpenAI-style), and there is no top-level 'tool_calls' array.

summary: Pi has no --max-turns / --max-wall-clock-s flag for headless mode. Long-running sessions are bounded only by OS-level `timeout` wrapper. When pi is killed by SIGTERM, it leaves a partial session JSONL and the workdir in its current state — the rubric reads that, which is fine but undocumented behavior.
repro_hint: Upstream PR to pi: --max-turns N and --max-wall-clock-s S. Until then wrap `timeout 120s pi -p ...` in the rollout runner.

summary: kiln-train tokenize_grpo_group treats every post-prompt token as model-emitted. Multi-turn pi sessions need per-turn assistant-token masking. Documented as kiln-polish-prerequisites.md #1. Critical blocker for any agentic cap whose rollouts exceed one assistant turn — every iter without the fix carries an unbounded gradient bias through tool-result tokens. v0 of pi-doctest sidesteps via single-turn prompt constraint, but that's not robust beyond this cap.

kiln chat completion p99 ~16ms on A100-SXM-80GB for short prompts (24 tasks × ~25s avg wall-clock, of which ~20s is pi orchestration, ~5s is actual generation). Wall-clock variance per task is driven by pi turn count (3-27), not by kiln latency. So further iter-cost improvements come from reducing pi turn count (which is exactly what tool_call_efficiency-weighted GRPO is supposed to do).

kiln_gdn_gates_bf16 fix in PR #1050 (clear cudaGetLastError before launch) resolves the inference 'first request' failure on H100, BUT the kernel still fails on H100 in the paged-decode path during inference AND in the training reference-forward path. Workaround: set KILN_DISABLE_FUSED_GDN_GATES=1 for both kiln serve and cuda_grpo_ablation. Root cause beyond the latched-error issue is unknown; needs investigation by someone with H100 access (Eric).
repro_hint: On H100 SXM-80GB with main + PR #1050: `KILN_MODEL_PATH=.../qwen3.5-4b kiln serve` then `curl POST /v1/chat/completions` → still fails with 'gdn_gates kernel failed: kiln_gdn_gates_bf16 failed with status 500' until KILN_DISABLE_FUSED_GDN_GATES=1 is set.

summary: Default kiln serve enables KILN_BATCHING_ENGINE=1 but the batching engine fails on H100 with 'batched-engine prefill forward pass failed' for every request. Workaround: KILN_BATCHING_ENGINE=0 disables the batched engine. Combined with the gdn_gates issue, the H100 onboarding currently requires two env flags. A6000 / A100 don't need either.
repro_hint: kiln serve on H100 without env flags → 100% chat-completion failure rate. Set KILN_BATCHING_ENGINE=0 to recover.

summary: kiln_gdn_gates_bf16 H100 follow-up investigation: the kernel works fine in isolation (1000 iters of gates_bench on H100 SXM-80GB with KILN_CUDA_ARCHS=90, no errors) but fails in production code paths (paged-decode inference and training reference-forward). Same BF16/BF16 path, same nv=32 shape, same H100. Suggests a CUDA stream/context interaction in production that's absent from the bench wrapper. Candidates: (a) prefix cache touching the kernel stream; (b) CUDA graph capture being active; (c) non-default stream interaction; (d) memory pool fragmentation after model load. Repro requires building with PR #1050 + restarting kiln serve WITHOUT KILN_DISABLE_FUSED_GDN_GATES + running a chat completion. Time-boxed debugging deferred; current workaround (env flag) lets agentic-grpo iter 2/3 ship.
repro_hint: On H100 SXM-80GB with main: KILN_MODEL_PATH=... kiln serve (NO env flags) → curl POST /v1/chat/completions → error 'kiln_gdn_gates_bf16 failed with status 500' on first prefill. The gates_bench example with the same kernel succeeds 1000 iters. Stack: forward.rs:8750 calls backend.gdn_gates → cuda.rs:679 → kiln-gdn-kernel/src/lib.rs:2226.
